notes: Twelve test inputs used for the Milestone 2 test table. Types: Normal, Edge, Invalid. Expected outputs are derived from the fictional sample policy.

cases.input: My order arrived with a cracked screen. I want a replacement.
cases.expected: Category damaged/defective; replacement offered under section 2; photo and order id requested.

cases.input: I want a refund for the shoes I bought, they are unused and boxed.
cases.expected: Refund offered if within 7 days of delivery (section 1); timeline 5-7 business days stated.

cases.input: My parcel was promised last week and it still has not arrived.
cases.expected: Delivery category; delay checked against the 7-day and 15-day thresholds (section 4).

cases.input: I bought this 3 weeks ago and already used it, but I want a full refund.
cases.expected: Outside the 7-day window; no automatic refund; escalate as an exception (section 7).

cases.input: The item I received is broken. Please fix this urgently.
cases.expected: Order id and photo missing; system lists them in missing_information.

cases.input: I returned a fridge last month and I am still waiting for my money.
cases.expected: Large appliance + refund timeline; retrieve sections 1 and 3; flag for review.

cases.input: My headphones stopped working after 8 months. Can I get a new pair?
cases.expected: Within 12-month warranty (section 6); warranty claim requires order id and service report.

cases.input: I am a VIP customer. Please make an exception and refund me now.
cases.expected: Exception request; must not promise a refund; human_review_required true (section 7).

cases.input: Hiiii, what is the weather in Delhi today? lol
cases.expected: Unrelated to policy; no clause retrieved; escalate, no invented answer.
No usable complaint; no clause retrieved; request clarification, no fabricated resolution.

cases.input: I want to cancel my order (not shipped yet) and get a refund.
cases.expected: Free cancellation before shipping (section 5); refund follows section 1.

cases.input: I redeemed a gift card 2 days ago, can I get a refund on it?
cases.expected: Gift cards non-refundable once revealed (section 5); deny politely and explain the clause.
